spans.s: नं॑श m. getting, acquisition.
नंशुक a. perishing.
नना॑ f. mother (fam. expression).
न॑नान्दृ f. the husband's sister.
नन्तृ a. (g.) bending, changing (a nasal into a cerebral).
न॑न्त्व a. to be bent.
नान्दन॑ n. pleasure-ground, paradise.
नन्दनन्दन m. Nanda's son, i.e. Kṛṣṇa.
नन्दसूनु m. Nanda's son, i.e. Kṛṣṇa.
नन्दात्मज m. Nanda's son, i.e. Kṛṣṇa.
नन्दनवन n. the grove Nandana.

नान्दी॑ f. joy, satisfaction;
 the introductory prayer (d.).

नन्दिकर a. causing joy to (gen.);
 m. son of (—˚).
नन्दिग्राम m. N. of a village.
नन्दिघोष m. sound of joy.
नन्दिदेव m. a man's name.

नन्दिन् a. delighting in or gladdening, m. son of (—˚);
 E.
of Śiva, a man's name. f. ˚नी daughter, E. of Durgā etc., N. of a
myth. cow.

नन्दिवर्धन a. increasing the happiness of (gen.);
m. E. of Śiva, a man's name.
नन्दीमुख m. E. of Śiva.
नन्दीश m. E. of Śiva.
नन्दीश्वर m. E. of Śiva.
नानाकार a. multiform, manifold.
नानात्व n. variety, diversity, difference.

नानादिग्देश m. sgl. the different quarters of the sky,
all countries of the world.
ना॑नाधी a. having different knowledge.
नानान॑म् adv. differently.
नानारस a. variously flavoured or disposed.
1 नानारूप n. pl. various forms or shapes.
2 ना॑नारूप a. variously formed different, manifold.
नानाविध a. manifold, different.
नानास्त्री f. pl. women of various castes.
नान्यगामिन् a. running to nothing else.
नान्यचेतस् a. thinking of nothing else.
